      name="school-service"
      cfg_mask_china_mobile="false"
      data_service="sqlite"
      org="doublechaintech"
      _module_key="root">

            name="Green Valley School"
            address="123 Education Lane"
            established_year="2005"
            create_time="createTime()"
            update_time="updateTime()"/>

             name="John Smith"
             subject="Mathematics"
             employee_id="EMP001"

             update_time="updateTime()"/>
             
  <student _name="Student"
             _module="Core"
             _module_key="core"

             grade="10"
             enrollment_date="2023-09-01"
             school="school()"
